title: SAGE: A Statistical Acceptance Gate for Self-Evolving Agents

rs.innovation_approach: 同题配对candidate/incumbent成功，显式计wins与regressions，非对称惩罚及单侧paired test决定接受或abstain。
rs.key_step: 从平均分改成逐item配对账本与保守门槛。
rs.why_non_obvious: 平均增益能掩盖已会题退化，最优候选选择受噪声偏差。
rs.trigger_condition: When repeated prompt edits are selected on noisy finite validation, compare paired wins/losses and abstain without reliable gains.
rs.abstract_strategy: 把候选验收变成有回归约束的统计决策。
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When repeated prompt edits are selected on noisy finite validation, compare paired wins/losses and abstain without reliable gains.

signatures.operation: 非对称paired criterion加单侧检验，优化器与预算匹配
signatures.claimed_effect: 作者报告19/20配置回归率下降、1持平；DeepSeek-V4 LiveMath36.5%→0，最终34.15→48.78。

evidence.quote: SAGE lowers the regression rate in 19 of 20 settings and matches the baseline in the remaining one

signatures.failure_boundary: HTML公式/table数值大部缺失，§3.3截断；具体test statistic、阈值及样本量未知。

relevance.how: 复用验证集自适应选择不能获trajectory-level error control。
逐itemwins/losses暴露平均分掩盖退化。
